title: Schneider Electric homeLYnk Controller (Update A)
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW CROSS-SITE SCRIPTING CWE-79 The homeLYnk controller is susceptible to a cross-site scripting attack. User inputs can be manipulated to cause execution of java script code. CVE-2017-5157 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 6.3 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ). --------- Begin Update A Part 2 of 2 -------- COMMAND INJECTION CWE-77 The homeLYnk controller has network features that can be manipulated via specially crafted POST requests. This vulnerability requires user interaction to be exploited. CVE-2017-7689 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 8.8 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). --------- End Update A Part 2 of 2 ---------- RESEARCHER Mohammed Shameem reported this issue to Schneider Electric.
